# ToolsVerse App — Free In-Browser Tools Suite

> ToolsVerse App (https://toolsverseapp.com) is an open-access, client-side productivity and utility suite featuring 103+ tools for PDF manipulation, document conversion, developer tasks, health calculators, and image processing. All computation executes 100% locally in the user's web browser using WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and the Web Crypto API, guaranteeing zero server uploads and complete data privacy.

## Core Features & Guarantees
- 100% In-Browser Execution: Zero bytes of user documents or data ever leave the device.
- Zero Sign-Up & No Paywalls: Free forever with unlimited conversions and no daily quotas.
- Strict Privacy: Architectural compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and FERPA standards.
- Offline Capability: Operates as an offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA).

## Popular Tools & Direct Links

### PDF Manipulation & Organization
- [Merge PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/organize-pdf/merge-pdf/): Combine multiple PDF documents into one single file with custom ordering and live preview.
- [Split PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/organize-pdf/split-pdf/): Split PDF files into individual pages or extract custom page ranges.
- [Compress PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/optimize-pdf/compress-pdf/): Reduce PDF file size with extreme, recommended, or light compression.
- [Sign PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/pdf-security/sign-pdf/): Place, resize, and rotate digital e-signatures on PDF documents.
- [Protect PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/pdf-security/protect-pdf/): Encrypt PDF files with 128-bit / 256-bit AES passwords.
- [Unlock PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/pdf-security/unlock-pdf/): Decrypt password-protected PDFs.
- [Redact PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/pdf-security/redact-pdf/): Permanently blackout sensitive corporate, financial, or personal information.
- [Scan to PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/convert-to-pdf/scan-to-pdf/): Capture documents via camera and assemble into a PDF.
- [PDF to Word](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/convert-from-pdf/pdf-to-word/): Convert PDF files into editable DOCX format.
- [Word to PDF](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/convert-to-pdf/word-to-pdf/): Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF format.
- [PDF to JPG](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/convert-from-pdf/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert PDF pages to high-resolution JPEG images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/convert-from-pdf/pdf-to-png/): Convert PDF pages to lossless PNG images.
- [Extract PDF Images](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/convert-from-pdf/extract-pdf-images/): Extract all photos and images from any PDF.

### Calculators & Daily Life
- [Age Calculator](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/calculators/age-calculator/): Calculate age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes.
- [BMI Calculator](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/calculators/bmi-calculator/): Calculate Body Mass Index and healthy weight category.
- [Loan Calculator](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/calculators/loan-calculator/): Calculate loan EMI, total interest, and monthly breakdown.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/calculators/percentage-calculator/): Percentage difference, increase, decrease, and fractions.
- [GPA Calculator](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/calculators/gpa-calculator/): Calculate college semester and cumulative GPA scores.

### Developer & Media Tools
- [JSON Formatter](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/developer/json-formatter/): Format, validate, and minify JSON data structures.
- [JWT Decoder](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/developer/jwt-decoder/): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens safely in-browser.
- [Image Compressor](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/media/image-compressor/): Compress PNG, JPEG, and WebP images.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolsverseapp.com/tools/design/qr-code-generator/): Create custom QR codes for URLs, WiFi, contacts, and text.
